## Synopsis

```text
perch account enable [OPTIONS]
```

## Description

Re-enable a previously disabled account.

## Options

| Option | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `--config <value>` | configuration file (default: ~/.config/perch/perch.yaml) |
| `--email <value>` | account email |
| `--help, -h` | show help |

## Examples

```sh
perch account enable --email you@example.com
```
